title: randia fasciculata
intro: Randia fasciculata, commonly known as the Indian plum or Malabar plum, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. It is a shrub or small tree that is native to tropical regions of the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Randia fasciculata include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, inflammation, and digestive issues, due to its therapeutic actions, which include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Randia fasciculata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
